## Checklist

- [ ] I followed the checklist for this kind of change in [docs/extending.md](https://github.com/opentouring/opentouring/blob/main/docs/extending.md), including who approves it and whether it needs an ADR.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off with `git commit -s` (Developer Certificate of Origin, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/opentouring/opentouring/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-off-dco)).
- [ ] The git hooks pass (writing rules, schema, OpenAPI, formatting, sign-off) and I did not skip them.
- [ ] New files start with the SPDX header for their directory ([LICENSING.md](https://github.com/opentouring/opentouring/blob/main/LICENSING.md)).
- [ ] Terms match [CONTEXT.md](https://github.com/opentouring/opentouring/blob/main/CONTEXT.md), and any new term is added there.
- [ ] Contract changes (`schema/`, `api/`) have examples, and after `v1.0.0` a line in CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] Nothing here publishes contributor identity beyond what the privacy policy draft allows.
